definitions.full: H7707. Shedeur שְׁדֵיאוּר proper name, masculine in Reuben (read probably ׳שׁ אוּר, שַׁדַּי is flame , see Nö ZMG xv (1860), 809 Neh Kg. 45 Gray Prop. N. 169, 197 ); — only in בֶּןשֿׁ ׳אֱלִיצוּר Num 1:5 ; 2:10 ; 7:30 , 35 ; 10:18 (all P); Σεδιονρ .
